entries.source:
You chant the glory of the Sun, granting you %d Mental Save and increasing your maximum life by %0.1f%% (Currently:  %d).
		You may only have one Chant active at once.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
颂赞日之荣耀，使你获得 %d 精神豁免，并增加 %0.1f%% 最大生命值（当前加成：%d）。
		同时只能激活一种赞歌。
		效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Lean, mean, and shaggy, it stares at you with hungry eyes.
entries.target: 它精瘦、凶悍、皮毛蓬松，正用饥饿的眼神盯着你。

entries.source: Eyes 9
entries.target: 眼睛9

entries.source: generic inc damage fire
entries.target: 通用 增加火焰伤害

entries.source:
Load incendiary ammunition, causing attacks to deal an additional %d%% weapon damage as fire in a radius %d ball around your target. 
		This cannot trigger more than once per turn.
		The damage will scale with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
装填燃烧弹，使你的攻击额外造成 %d%% 武器伤害的火焰伤害，作用于以目标为中心、半径 %d 的范围内。
		该技能每回合最多触发一次。
		伤害受物理强度加成。

entries.source: Deep in the Dreadfell you fought and destroyed the Master, a powerful vampire.
entries.target: 在恐惧王座深处你与领主——一个强大的吸血鬼——战斗并消灭了他。

entries.source:
You see a mural showing a huge metropolis made of crystal, with small islands of stone floating in the air behind it. In the foreground is sitting a Sher'Tul, with a hand stretched up to the sky.
There is some text beneath
entries.target:
你在壁画上看到一个巨大的水晶之城，有数个浮空岛悬浮在周围。在画面的最前端坐着的是夏·图尔人，他向天空笔直的举起手臂。
下面有一行文字

entries.source: generic phys crit
entries.target: 通用 物理暴击

entries.source: The Doomed strike from behind a veil of darkness or a host of shadows.
entries.target: 末日使者操纵阴影，从黑暗中发动攻击。

entries.source:
Your fungus reaches into the primordial ages of the world, granting you ancient instincts.
		Each time you receive non-regeneration healing you gain %0.1f%% of a turn per 100 life healed.  This effect can't add energy past 2 stored turns and overhealing is not counted.
		Also, regeneration effects on you will decrease your equilibrium by %0.1f each turn.
		The turn gain increases with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
你的孢子可以追溯到创世纪元，你可以传承来自远古的天赋。
		每当你获得一个非回复的治疗效果，每治疗 100 点生命值，你获得 %0.1f%% 个回合。
		这一效果最多获得 2 个回合。
		同时，每当你受到回复作用时，每回合你的失衡值将会减少 %0.1f。
		增益回合受精神强度加成。

entries.source: If you lose more than this percentage of life in a turn, a warning will display and all key/mouse input will be ignored for 2 seconds to prevent mistakes.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当你在一回合内损失了超过该百分比的生命时，将弹出提醒并暂时关闭鼠标、键盘操作2秒。#WHITE#

entries.source: vial of iron-colored fluid
entries.target: 一瓶铁色液体。

entries.source: Engaged in a grapple draining %d stamina per turn and redirecting %d%% of damage taken to %s.  Any movement will break the effect as will some unarmed talents.
entries.target: 目标进入抓取状态，每回合吸取 %d 体力，同时将 %d%% 伤害转移到 %s。任何移动或其他一些徒手技能都会取消这个状态。

entries.source: Your Rogue's Brew fortifies you for 8 turns, preventing you from dying until you reach -%d life.
entries.target: 你的盗贼佳酿会强化你 8 回合，使你在生命值降至 -%d 之前不会死亡。

entries.source: dual techniques
entries.target: 双持战技

entries.source: Grappling techniques that may not be practiced in massive armor or while a weapon or shield is equipped.
entries.target: 抓取敌人的技巧，你不能装备板甲、武器和盾牌。

entries.source: Slippery Ground
entries.target: 地面光滑

entries.source: Blood Spray
entries.target: 鲜血喷射

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have learned the talent Confusion.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你学会了技能混乱。

entries.source: @Target@ walks on a trap, and there is a loud noise.
entries.target: @Target@踩上陷阱，发出了巨大的声音。
